full_judgment: 35. The learned Judges wrongly drew adverse presumption for not examining the Deputy Collector and Inspector Shafiar Rahman. Recovery of gold is admitted and the Deputy Collector is only a witness to the said recovery. Both PWs 1 and 2 proved that in their presence the respondent produced his baggage for examination and so the examination of Shafiar Rahman would have only added to the number without improvement of the quality of the evidence.
